doctorPage.name: Dr. Alaa Zaki
doctorPage.title: Clinical Aesthetic Pharmacist & Non-Surgical Aesthetics Specialist
doctorPage.bio1: With over 5 years of dedicated experience in advanced aesthetic medicine, Dr. Alaa Zaki has established herself as a pioneer in non-surgical facial harmonization in Hurghada. Merging a profound understanding of facial anatomy with a refined artistic eye, she specializes in delivering bespoke, natural-looking results.
doctorPage.bio2: Graduating with top honors and subsequently training under global leaders in aesthetic dermatology across Europe and the Middle East, Dr. Alaa constantly brings the latest, evidence-based clinical innovations to Hurghada Beauty Hub. Her approach prioritizes patient safety, utilizing only FDA-approved injectables and state-of-the-art modalities to reverse the signs of aging while preserving your unique identity.
doctorPage.quote: True beauty is not about altering who you are, but revealing the masterpiece that already exists within you. Precision, safety, and artistry are the pillars of my practice.
